question: How are advance payments invoiced under UAE e-invoicing?

card.head: Advance payment received? Invoice it on receipt.
card.sub: The final invoice then covers only the balance.

figure.label: Go‑live for in‑scope businesses with revenue of AED 50m+. Set up advance and retention invoicing first.

cta.d: ERP integration and testing support for e‑invoicing. Valorin is not an ASP.

scenes.head: Took an advance? Invoice it on receipt.
scenes.say: Took an advance from a customer? The UAE e-invoicing guidelines say you invoice it when the money arrives.

scenes.head: One contract, two invoices
scenes.note: AED thousands, excluding VAT. Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.src: UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines V2.0, s. 17 (UAE Ministry of Finance, 26 Oct 2026); checked 7 Nov 2026.
scenes.say: Say a contract is worth one million dirhams, with three hundred thousand paid up front. The advance is invoiced on receipt. The final invoice is seven hundred thousand plus VAT, not the full million.
That's from the Ministry of Finance's guidelines, version two. Going live on the first of January? Check all three in your E R P.
